QuestInfo.name: Making a Really Big Saddle
QuestInfo.0: Go to #b#p2060005##k in #b#m230000000##k and ask him to make you a Really Big Saddle.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2060005# says that you are the only person who has ever asked him to make three different saddles and agrees to make a saddle big enough for #p1013000#. Bring him the required materials and mesos.

#i4000232# #t4000232# #b#c4000232# / 300#k
#i4000233# #t4000233# #b#c4000233# / 300#k
#i4000234# #t4000234# #b#c4000234# / 300#k
#b60000000 Mesos#k
QuestInfo.2: You received a Really Big Saddle from #p2060005#. You can only hope that you won't need any more saddles.

0.0: Hi, how are you? The special animal you are raising seems to be growing well. His horn and wings have gotten so big... It looks like he's going to need a new saddle.
0.1: The materials that were used to make the current saddle won't be able to handle his bigger size or his sharper and stronger scales. He's going to need a saddle made with stronger materials.

yes.0: Please bring me #b300 #t4000232#s#k from the #r#o8140102##k, #b300 pieces of #t4000233##k from the #r#o8140103##k, and #b300 #t4000234#s#k from the #r#o8140101##k. With those materials, I will surely be able to make a new saddle, suitable for #p1013000#.
yes.1: The only thing is that those materials are much more difficult to handle than before so I'm going to have to charge you a higher fee. It's going to me 60000000 mesos. Your eyes are spinning from all those 0s. Simply stated, it will cost #b60 million mesos#k.
yes.2: I realize how expensive that sounds but it's an adequate price for the skill it takes to make a saddle using those materials. If the #m230000003# cost less to operate, I might be able to give you a discount, but as you can see, there are so few visitors here at the #m230000003#...
yes.3: But since you're raising an animal that must cost a fortune to feed, you must be very well off. 60 million mesos is probably nothing to you. Heck, someone like you could probably buy dozens of saddles.
yes.4: I will be here waiting for you to bring all the materials.

no.0: Hmm... I guess you're not as rich as I thought. If it's too difficult for you, it's not a bad idea to level up a bit more and save some more money.

1.0: You've brought all the materials! And the 60 million mesos as well! I knew it, I really have a good eye for picking out rich people... I mean... Nevermind. Now, please give the materials to me. I will make your new saddle right away.

yes.0: I've made the saddle strong enough to protect the rider from the sharp scales while still being very light. There is also a safety feature to protect the rider from falling off. Enjoy your new saddle and please let me know if you lose it!

item.0: You still haven't gathered all the materials for the saddle? Bring me #b300 #t4000232#s#k from the #r#o8140102##k, #b300 pieces of #t4000233##k from the #r#o8140103##k, and #b300 #t4000234#s#k from the #r#o8140101##k. And don't forget the fee of 60 million Mesos. I'll be waiting.
